# `csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls`

When a chain breaks, leave the dot at the end of the preceding line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

### `csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = true`

```ini
csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").Append("World").Append("!").ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").Append("World").Append("!").ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

::::
